[P2] Resolve plugin enrichment from the active execution

When two `withDurableExecution` handlers with different plugin configurations share one adapter and overlap, the adapter retains the logging context of whichever handler configured it last. `getDurableLogData()` correctly resolves the active execution, but this closure always calls the captured handler’s plugin. Consequently, the first handler’s logs receive the second handler’s plugin fields—or lose enrichment entirely if that handler has no plugins. Carry the enrichment callback in the active execution context and resolve it per call, using the captured context only as a fallback. Add an interleaved two-handler regression test with distinct plugin fields.
